summary: Completed testing of Referral Milestone Rewards feature. All 5 milestones (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond) are correctly implemented with proper status tracking (locked/claimable/claimed). Backend APIs working correctly. Frontend UI displays milestones with progress bar, claim buttons, and green checkmarks for claimed milestones.
passed_tests: GET /api/referral/milestones - Returns all 5 milestones with correct structure
GET /api/referral/milestones - Returns correct reward values (Bronze:100, Silver:300, Gold:600, Platinum:1500, Diamond:4000)
GET /api/referral/milestones - Milestone status logic (is_reached, is_claimed, can_claim) works correctly
POST /api/referral/milestones/{id}/claim - Returns 404 for invalid milestone ID
POST /api/referral/milestones/{id}/claim - Returns 400 when trying to claim unreached milestone
POST /api/referral/milestones/{id}/claim - Returns 400 when trying to claim already claimed milestone
POST /api/referral/milestones/{id}/claim - Successfully claims milestone and adds coins to balance
Milestone endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
Profile page shows Milestones card with '30 referrals' count
Progress bar shows 'Next: Gold 30/50' with '20 more to unlock 600 coins!'
Bronze milestone shows green 'Claimed' status with checkmark
Silver milestone shows green 'Claimed' status with checkmark
Gold, Platinum, Diamond milestones show locked (lock icon) status
Claim button appears for claimable milestones (yellow pulsing button)
Clicking Claim button adds coins to user balance (290 -> 390 after Bronze claim)
Success toast shows 'Congratulations! You claimed the Bronze milestone!'
Milestone status updates immediately after claim (Claim! -> Claimed)
